entries.title: Jeremiah 42:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Good or evil - Whether grateful or ungrateful to us.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:10
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: I repent - I am satisfied with the punishment your nation hath undergone, and as to the remainder, will change the course of my providence.
